mapper.sql: id, student_id, title, details, status, completed_at, create_time, update_time, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM personal_goal WHERE id=#{id} AND student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE personal_goal SET title=#{title},details=#{details},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND version=#{version}

UPDATE personal_goal SET completed_at=CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN COALESCE(completed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ELSE NULL END, status=CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND version=#{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM personal_goal WHERE id=#{id} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND version=#{version}
